text: During [a séance in New York|trigger|calling on unseen powers], Mary Woodhouse sees a vision of Father Thomas hanging himself in the cemetery of a village called Dunwich, and is nearly buried alive. The priest's death has opened the gates of Hell, and [the dead will walk|threat|the dead that rise] once All Saints' Day begins. In Dunwich a window drips blood, a dead girl returns to her family, and a room is [showered with maggots|images|vermin and creeping things] as Mary and the journalist Peter Bell race [toward midnight|rules|death on a deadline].
